entities.name: Tongyang Broadcasting Company
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Tongyang Broadcasting Company was a South Korean commercial television station which was merged by the government with KBS. It was owned by the Samsung Group founder Lee Byung-chul and was a sister company to the JoongAng Ilbo.
